attributes.action: Recognise Communism & Revolutionary Socialism as far-left extremist ideologies.
attributes.additional_details: Communism and Revolutionary Socialism have aimed to overthrow liberal parliamentary democracy, linked to estimates of 94–110 million deaths via politicides, genocides, democides, and ethnocides through mass killings, forced labour, and famines. The Hammer and Sickle was their central symbol. Update official counter-extremism guidance and the 2024 extremism definition to recognise them as far-left extremist ideologies and the symbol as a hate symbol for consistent Prevent and police guidance.
attributes.background: Update official counter-extremism guidance and the 2024 extremism definition to recognise Communism and Revolutionary Socialism as far-left extremist ideologies aiming to overthrow or replace liberal parliamentary democracy, and recognise the Hammer and Sickle as a hate symbol of those ideologies.

rejection.details:
Insofar as communism and revolutionary socialism do indeed seek to overthrow liberal democracy they are already included in the definition of extremism and therefore will be covered in Prevent guidance:

current Government 2024 extremism definition here:
https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/new-definition-of-extremism-2024/new-definition-of-extremism-2024
